LanguageData.LP_FallenEmpyrean.label: the fallen titanborn
LanguageData.LP_FallenEmpyrean.description:
A celestial titanborn lost a war in the heavens and fell to the mortal world. Two mortals found it at the edge of the crater and have followed it ever since. The halo above the titanborn's head remains, but little of its divine might is left.

The starting titanborn excels at melee and social; it's two and a half times as tall as an ordinary person, with health and melee far beyond normal, but a big appetite too, and it can't stand anything taller than itself. Faerûn's pioneer league is in awe of visitors from the sky (goodwill +20). Around day 10 the Thayan expedition follows the meteor's trail to seize the titanborn.

Recommended path: titan awakening. Difficulty: medium. The titanborn starts having acknowledged a divine father (random among the seven worshippable gods, named in the opening letter); the titan awakening path is already open, and the "theurgy" research is complete.

Note: the titanborn can't reproduce and there's only this one; its mood is written straight into the sky: clear skies when it's happy, thunderstorms when it's upset.

LanguageData.LP_FallenEmpyrean.scenario.parts.Configu: A celestial titanborn and two mortal followers.
LanguageData.LP_FallenEmpyrean.scenario.parts.GameSta:
You fell from the heavens for a long time.

The crater still smokes, and the halo above your head flickers. Two mortals kneel at the edge of the pit, holding your still-humming sword.

The war in the heavens has nothing to do with you anymore. But the Red Wizards have smelled the meteor; before they arrive, make this land remember the titanborn's name.
